# translationCore

> translationCore is a set of free, open-source tools from unfoldingWord that help churches and translation teams understand, translate, and check Scripture in their own languages. translationCore Desktop (Windows, Mac, and Linux) is a workspace to draft, check, align, and share a translation. translationCore Mobile (Android, iPhone, and the web) is for oral translation: record, listen back, and improve. Both work offline.

### Frequently asked questions

#### Is translationCore free?

Yes. translationCore Desktop and Mobile are free and open source, and the Biblical Resources are open-licensed and free to use, share, and adapt.

#### Does translationCore work offline?

Yes. Both translationCore Desktop and translationCore Mobile work offline.

#### Which devices does translationCore run on?

translationCore Desktop runs on Windows, Mac, and Linux. translationCore Mobile runs on Android, iPhone, and the web.

#### Who makes translationCore?

translationCore is an initiative of unfoldingWord.

Page title: translationCore Desktop | Bible translation workspace

Home / translationCore Desktop

## An end-to-end workspace for Bible translation

Draft, check, align, and share a translation in one app. Works offline. Download View on GitHub New: translationCore v4 Beta · Windows, Mac, Linux

Translate mode, with notes and source text beside you.

### Understand. Translate. Check.

translationNotes, translationWords, translationQuestions, translationAcademy, ULT, and UST work together in one workspace, so you can understand Scripture and translate it accurately and clearly. Understand Translate Check

Understand. Read the passage and its notes before you start.

Translate. Draft beside the source text, a section at a time.

Check. Review each item against the original, then mark it valid.

### Everything your team needs, in one place

#### Draft a section

Write a section, then place verse numbers.

#### Original language beside you

See Greek or Hebrew next to the ULT and UST.

#### Helps and suggestions

Notes, words, comments, and alignment suggestions.

#### Check and align

Check key terms, then align to the original.

#### Open Bible Stories

Translate and check stories. Export Markdown or PDF.

#### Export and share

Export aligned USFM, a Scripture Burrito, or PDF, or share to Door43.

### How it works

1 Start a project, or import one.

2 Draft a section at a time.

3 Check with helps beside you.

4 Align to the original language.

5 Export or share to Door43.

Switch between ULT, UST, and the Greek source

Draft a whole section, then place verse numbers

Notes link to Translation Academy

### Have a translation question? Ask BT Servant.

Get guidance grounded in trusted resources, in your language.

### Download translationCore v4 Beta

Choose your computer.

#### Windows

Installer (.exe), 64-bit

Signed by unfoldingWord. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info, check that the publisher is unfoldingWord, then choose Run anyway. Download for Windows

#### Mac

Installer (.pkg), Apple silicon

Intel Macs are not supported yet. This build is not signed yet, so macOS may block it. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway, or Control-click the installer and choose Open. It asks for an administrator password. Download for Mac

#### Linux

Zip (.zip), 64-bit

Unpack the zip and run start-tc4.sh . Download for Linux

New: translationCore v4 Beta. Test with copies of your projects and keep backups.

Need help? See the help site or the release notes .

The previous version stays available until v4 Beta is stable. Go to the previous version

Page title: translationCore Mobile | Record Scripture in your language

Home / translationCore Mobile

translationCore Mobile

## Record Scripture in your own language

One passage at a time, on the phone you already have. Works offline.

Get the app Free · Open source

### A simple app for oral translation

Record by book, chapter, and segment. Listen back, fix, and share, all on your phone.

#### Works offline

Once installed, no internet needed.

#### Stays on your phone

No accounts, no ads, and no tracking.

#### Simple controls

Large icon buttons, built for teams who work by ear.

#### Free and open source

From unfoldingWord, shaped by facilitators and testers.

### How to use it

Books and chapters

Segments, one by one

Record

Cut and fix in place

1 Record a segment, then listen back.

2 Fix it by cutting part of the waveform, or record it again.

3 Mark Done when the segment is ready.

4 Share a chapter as an MP3, or a book as a zip.

### Talk through a passage before you record.

Ask by voice or text, listen to the guidance, then return to translationCore Mobile to record. Try BT Servant →

### Get translationCore Mobile

#### Android

Search “translationCore Mobile” on Google Play.

Android 7.0 or later, with WebView up to date. Get it on Google Play

#### iPhone

Search “translationCore Mobile” on the App Store.

iOS 15.4 or later. Get it on the App Store

#### Web

Open it in your browser. Nothing to install.

tcmobile.app Open tcmobile.app

Questions? Contact unfoldingWord · Source on GitHub

Test whether your translation is clear.

2 Ask the chapter questions.

## The earlier translationCore

Still need the version you know? It stays here until v4 Beta is stable. Go to translationCore v4 Beta

### Download

translationCore® is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux in both Full and Minimal (Lite) install packages.

#### Full Install

Includes all resources for offline use.

Windows: x64 | x86

macOS: x64 | Universal

Linux: x64 | ARM64

#### Minimal Install

Lighter download; fetches resources as needed.

Windows: x64 | x86

macOS: x64 | Universal

Linux: x64 | ARM64

See the Release Notes for installation instructions.

The translationCore source code is open source, released under the MIT License . You are free to use, copy, modify, and distribute the code, as long as the copyright and license notice stay with it.

## Website Privacy Policy

How unfoldingWord collects, uses, and protects information on this website. Back to Home

Last revised: November 5, 2026

### Introduction

unfoldingWord ( "Company" or "We" ) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting it through our compliance with this policy.

This policy describes the types of information we may collect from you or that you may provide when you visit the website translationcore.com (our " Website ") and our practices for collecting, using, maintaining, protecting, and disclosing that information. As used in this Privacy Policy, our Website includes the translationcore.com website, other unfoldingWord websites, as well as the Door43 Discussion Forums, which are linked to in various locations on unfoldingword.org.

This policy applies to information we collect:

On this Website, to include the Discussion Forums at forum.door43.org.

In email, text, and other electronic messages between you and this Website.

Through mobile and desktop applications you download from this Website, which provide dedicated non-browser-based interaction between you and this Website.

It does not apply to information collected by:

Us offline or through any other means, including on any other website operated by any third party; or

Any third party, including through any application or content (including advertising) that may link to or be accessible from the Website.

Please read this policy carefully to understand our policies and practices regarding your information and how we will treat it. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, your choice is to not use our Website. By accessing or using this Website, you agree to this privacy policy. This policy may change from time to time (see Changes to Our Privacy Policy ). Your continued use of this Website after we make changes is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates.

### Children Under the Age of 18

OUR WEBSITE IS NOT INTENDED FOR CHILDREN UNDER 18 YEARS OF AGE. No one under age 18 should use this website, to include providing any personal information to or on the Website. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18.

If you are under 18, do not use or provide any information on this Website, to include any information about yourself such as your name, address, telephone number, email address, or any screen name or user name you may use. Please have your parent or guardian use the site on your behalf.

If we learn we have collected or received personal information from a child under 18 without verification of parental consent, we will delete that information. If you believe we might have any information from or about a child under 18, please contact us at:

13485 Veterans Way, Suite 460

Attention: Privacy

Orlando, FL 32827

California residents under 16 years of age may have additional rights regarding the collection and sale of their personal information. Please see Your California Privacy Rights for more information.

### Information We Collect About You and How We Collect It

We collect several types of information from and about users of our Website, including information:

By which you may be personally identified, such as name, postal address, e-mail address, telephone number, or other personally identifiable information you may provide to us (" personal information ");

Information you provide through communications, such as posts on Discussion Forums and through contact forms on the Website; and

About your internet connection, the equipment you use to access our Website, and usage details.

We collect this information:

Directly from you when you provide it to us.

Automatically as you navigate through the site. Information collected automatically may include usage details, IP addresses, and information collected through cookies or other legal tracking technologies.

Information You Provide to Us

The information we collect on or through our Website may include:

Information that you provide by filling in forms on our Website.

Information when you download an application from our Website.

Information when you report a problem with our Website.

Records and copies of your correspondence (including email addresses), if you contact us.

Details of donations you carry out through our Website. You may be required to provide financial information before making a donation through our Website.

Your search queries on the Website.

Information you provide on Discussion Forums.

You also may provide information to be published or displayed (hereinafter, " posted ") on public areas of the Website, or transmitted to other users of the Website or third parties (collectively, " User Contributions "). Your User Contributions are posted on and transmitted to others at your own risk. Information you provide on public areas of the Website, to include the Discussion Forums, will be viewable to other users.

### Information We Collect Through Automatic Data Collection Technologies

As you navigate through and interact with our Website, we may use automatic data collection technologies to collect certain information about your equipment, browsing actions, and patterns, including:

Details of your visits to our Website, including traffic data, location data, logs, and other communication data and the resources that you access and use on the Website.

Information about your computer and internet connection, including your IP address, operating system, and browser type.

The information we collect automatically may include personal information, and we may maintain it or associate it with personal information we collect in other ways. It helps us to improve our Website and to deliver a better and more personalized service, including by enabling us to:

Estimate our audience size, broad demographic trends, and usage patterns.

Store information about your preferences, allowing us to customize our Website according to your individual interests.

Speed up your searches.

Recognize you when you return to our Website.

Enhance website security.

The technologies we use for this automatic data collection may include:

Cookies (or browser cookies). A cookie is a small file placed on the hard drive of your computer. You may refuse to accept browser cookies by activating the appropriate setting on your browser. However, if you select this setting you may be unable to access certain parts of our Website. Unless you have adjusted your browser setting so that it will refuse cookies, our system will issue cookies when you direct your browser to our Website.

Flash Cookies. Certain features of our Website may use local stored objects (or Flash cookies) to collect and store information about your preferences and navigation to, from, and on our Website. Flash cookies are not managed by the same browser settings as are used for browser cookies. For information about managing your privacy and security settings for Flash cookies, see Choices About How We Use and Disclose Your Information .

Analytics. We use Google Analytics to count visits and downloads on this Website, such as which pages are viewed and which download links are selected. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies.

Web Beacons. Pages of our the Website and our e-mails may contain small electronic files known as web beacons (also referred to as clear gifs, pixel tags, and single-pixel gifs) that permit the Company, for example, to count users who have visited those pages or opened an email and for other related website statistics (for example, recording the popularity of certain website content and verifying system and server integrity).

### How We Use Your Information

We use information that we collect about you or that you provide to us, including any personal information:

To present our Website and its contents to you.

To provide you with information, products, or services that you request from us.

To carry out our obligations and enforce our rights arising from any contracts entered into between you and us.

To notify you about changes to our Website or any products or services we offer or provide though it.

To allow you to participate in interactive features on our Website.

To respond to your questions and feedback provided through webforms.

To interact with you through interactive sections of our Website or the Door43 Forums.

In any other way we may describe when you provide the information.

To fulfill any other purpose for which you provide it.

We may also use your information to contact you about our own and third-parties' missions and services that may be of interest to you. For more information, see Choices About How We Use and Disclose Your Information.

### Disclosure of Your Information

We may disclose aggregated information about our users, and information that does not identify any individual, without restriction.

We may disclose personal information that we collect or that you provide as described in this privacy policy:

To our subsidiaries and affiliates.

To contractors, service providers, and other third parties we use to support our business.

To a buyer or other successor in the event of a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution, or other sale or transfer of some or all of unfoldingWord's assets, whether as a going concern or as part of bankruptcy, liquidation, or similar proceeding, in which personal information held by unfoldingWord about our Website users is among the assets transferred.

To fulfill the purpose for which you provide it.

Pursuant to a Court Order requesting the disclosure of specific information.

Where we determine that the disclosure of specific information is necessary to comply with the request of a law enforcement or regulatory agency.

For any other purpose disclosed by us when you provide the information.

With your consent.

To enforce or apply our terms of use.

If we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to protect the rights, property, or safety of unfoldingWord, our customers, or others.

### Choices About How We Use and Disclose Your Information

We strive to provide you with choices regarding the personal information you provide to us. We have created mechanisms to provide you with the following control over your information:

Tracking Technologies and Advertising. You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, or to alert you when cookies are being sent. To learn how you can manage your Flash cookie settings, visit the Flash player settings page on Adobe's website. If you disable or refuse cookies, please note that some parts of this site may then be inaccessible or not function properly.

Promotional Offers from the Company. If you do not wish to have your email address used by the Company to promote our services, you can opt-out by replying to an email from us, stating your request to be omitted from future email distributions.

California residents may have additional personal information rights and choices. Please see Your California Privacy Rights for more information.

### Your California Privacy Rights

If you are a California resident, California law may provide you with additional rights regarding our use of your personal information. To learn more about your California privacy rights, visit The California Department of Justice website at https://oag.ca.gov/privacy/ccpa.

### Data Security

Our Website has security measures in place to help protect against the loss, misuse and alteration of the personally identifiable information under its control. We employ reasonable security measures consistent with standard industry practice to help protect against public access to personally identifiable and account activity information collected on the Website and used by us. For instance, access to our databases with personally identifiable information is logged for security purposes and access is limited to key personnel. Personally identifiable information and account activity are also protected through the use of user names and passwords.

The safety and security of your information also depends on you. Where we have given you (or where you have chosen) a password for access to certain parts of our Website, you are responsible for keeping this password confidential. We ask you not to share your password with anyone. We urge you to be careful about giving out information in public areas of the Website like the Door43 Forums. The information you share in public areas may be viewed by any user of the Website.

Unfortunately, the transmission of information via the internet is not completely secure. Although we do our best to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee the security of your personal information transmitted to our Website. Any transmission of personal information is at your own risk. We are not responsible for circumvention of any privacy settings or security measures contained on the Website.

### Changes to Our Privacy Policy

It is our policy to post any changes we make to our privacy policy on this page. The date the privacy policy was last revised is identified at the top of the page. You are responsible periodically visiting our Website and this privacy policy to check for any changes.
